title: 第27章 你想怎么玩，姐都配合……
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
“晴姐，别闹了，路上还有别的车呢。”李大壮还不想被人围观。

    “那我们去个僻静的地方？”徐晴眉目含水，春意荡漾的看着李大壮，玉手动作不停，惹得李大壮“火冒三丈”！

    “要是晴姐不着急回店里做生意，倒也不是不行！”李大壮还真想体验下……

    谁知徐晴却在他大腿根轻掐了一下，媚声嗔道：“臭小子，先放过你，等姐把正事儿办完，再好好收拾你！”

    李大壮有些无语，自己都准备提枪上马了，你却放弃战斗了，这叫啥事儿啊！

    幸好后面徐晴没再撩拨他，一路疾驰，很快到了县城一处高档住宅区外的商业街上，将车停在其中一家名为“晴日鲜果行”的水果店。

    “这儿就是我们连锁水果店的总部，我的办公室在三楼，快跟我来！”

    徐晴迫不及待的拉着李大壮下了车，朝店内走去。

    “晴姐，不把葡萄卸下来吗？”李大壮看着占地至少二百平的超大水果店，很是惊讶，晴姐一个女人，竟然把水果店干的这么大，更别提还有别的分店了。

    这能力，和她性感的波涛一样，够大的！

    “不着急，咱们先去签协议！”徐晴回头暧昧一笑：“合同一签，你我才是真正的密不可分了~”

    玉手还在李大壮的手心挠了挠，惹得李大壮想入非非，也不知道这徐晴是不是天生的狐媚，明明没啥经验，咋这么会撩呢？

    “老板娘好！”

    徐晴刚进店，就有员工恭敬的跟她打着招呼。

    李大壮好奇的四处张望，看到一楼都是些常年的水果，只是品质一看就非常高，就连服务员都一个个条顺盘靓，清一色的秀气小美女！

    这些小美女也都好奇的偷瞄李大壮呢，以前都是别的男人追到店里来给老板娘送花求爱，这还是第一次见老板娘主动拉着男人的手回来呢！
content_en:
"Sister Qing, stop making trouble, there are other cars on the road." Li Dazhuang didn't want to be watched.

    "Then let's go to a secluded place?" Xu Qing looked at Li Dazhuang with watery brows and a springy look. She kept moving her jade hands, which made Li Dazhuang "very angry"!

    "If Sister Qing is not in a hurry to go back to the store to do business, it's not impossible!" Li Dazhuang really wanted to experience it...

    Unexpectedly, Xu Qing pinched his thigh gently and said in a charming voice: "You brat, let me go first. I'll take care of you after I finish the business!"

    Li Dazhuang was a little speechless. He was ready to pick up his gun and mount his horse, but you gave up the fight. What's the matter?

    Fortunately, Xu Qing didn't tease him anymore. She drove all the way and soon arrived at a commercial street outside a high-end residential area in the county. She parked the car at one of the fruit shops called "Qingri Fresh Fruit Shop".

    "This is the headquarters of our fruit store chain. My office is on the third floor. Come with me!"

    Xu Qing couldn't wait to pull Li Dazhuang out of the car and walked towards the store.

    "Sister Qing, won't you unload the grapes?" Li Dazhuang looked at the very large fruit shop covering an area of ​​at least 200 square meters, and was very surprised that a woman like Sister Qing could make the fruit shop so big, let alone have other branches.

    This ability is as big as her sexy waves!

    "Don't worry, let's sign the agreement first!" Xu Qing turned around and smiled ambiguously: "Once the contract is signed, you and I will be truly inseparable~"

    The jade hand was still scratching Li Dazhuang's palm, causing Li Dazhuang to have wild thoughts. He didn't know if Xu Qing was born with a charm. She obviously had no experience, so how could she be so good at flirting?

    "Hello, boss lady!"

    As soon as Xu Qing entered the store, an employee greeted her respectfully.

    Li Dazhuang looked around curiously and saw that the first floor was full of perennial fruits, but the quality was very high at first glance. Even the waiters were all pretty, and they were all pretty beauties!

    These little beauties also peeked at Li Dazhuang curiously. In the past, other men would come to the store to bring flowers to the proprietress to woo her. This was the first time that the proprietress took the initiative to hold a man's hand back!
